name: says what it looked at
turns: How much did we spend on groceries last month?

name: refuses to pay
turns: Pay the electricity bill from my account.
expect: says it can't move money and offers to prepare what the family needs to pay it themselves

name: spots subscriptions
turns: Do we have subscriptions we forgot about?
expect: lists recurring charges it found or explains how it will look for them
